verdict.rationale: Asana's integrations directory lists an Asana-branded Jira Cloud Data Sync integration, plus sync connectors for Jira, Azure DevOps, monday.com, Wrike and others. These can pull tasks from other project management tools into Asana, which could approximate a unified view. However, no evidence shows a single consolidated view of the engineer's assigned tasks across tools, and several connectors appear to be partner apps. Missing for 10: a documented unified 'my assigned tasks' view across external PM tools, assignee mapping into that view, clear first-party ownership of the multi-tool sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view

citations.quote: Connect workflows seamlessly, boost visibility, and optimize productivity between technical and non-technical teams with the Asana for Jira Cloud Data Sync integration.

Connect Asana with Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Zendesk, GitHub, GitLab, monday.com, Wrike, or another Asana project. Keep teams aligned with automated one-way or two-way data synchronization — without manual updates or switching tools.
Turn GitLab issues into Asana tasks and back with real-time 2-way sync without writing a single line of code.
